[To [Alexander Macmillan](/person/939)]
I would think that [Mr Lea](/person/853)’s proposal was a very good one, and that the [Golden Deeds](/book/51) might be very useful as such a class book. But I imagine that to give it currency, it would be advisable to get it placed on the list of books recommended by the Council of Education people. I suppose there would have to be some omissions to make it into so cheap a book.

Yours sincerely

C M Yonge
